collection.description: Multiplayer dedicated game servers powered by SteamCMD and native game engines

shard.name: Team Fortress 2
shard.description: Valve's legendary team-based multiplayer first-person shooter dedicated server on the Source engine.
shard.author: Valve & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Team Fortress 2 Dedicated Server Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apt update && apt install -y curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/steamcmd
cd /tmp/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz"
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz

echo "Installing Team Fortress 2 (App ID 232250)..."
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 232250 validate +quit

cd /mnt/server
chmod +x srcds_run srcds_linux
echo "Team Fortress 2 installation completed!"
